# EnoughEdu

EnoughEdu is an engineering student toolkit and a portfolio project by Vedhant Khajuria.

- Website: https://enoughedu.vedhant.in
- Portfolio: https://vedhant.in
- Contact: hello@vedhant.in
- Tools: https://enoughedu.vedhant.in/tools
- Resources: https://enoughedu.vedhant.in/resources
- Pricing: https://enoughedu.vedhant.in/pricing

Features include academic calculators, study planners, career tools and browser-based PDF utilities. Some features require an account or a purchase. Current availability and prices are shown on the website.
